name: Washington Square, San Francisco
description: A 360 × 360 metre interpretation of North Beach, traced from a north-up USDA NAIP aerial acquired 20 May 2024. Plan features are observed and simplified; most heights and ground-level boundaries are estimates. This is a spatial sketch, not a measured survey.

origin.note: Southwest corner. x east, y north. Scaled Web Mercator local frame (cos 37.8008°); reference image 1200 × 1200 px at 0.3 local m/px. See public/reference/washington-square-georeference.json.

sources.title: USDA NAIP aerial · 20 May 2024
sources.attribution: USDA Farm Production and Conservation, National Agriculture Imagery Program. Public-domain U.S. government imagery.
sources.notes: Raster m_3712213_se_10_060_20240520 (OBJECTID 11934), 0.6 m source. Downloaded north-up as 1200 px JPEG, 0.3 local m/px (resampled, not additional detail). Local reference: /reference/washington-square-naip.jpg. Geometry hand-traced; no OSM data used.

sources.title: Saints Peter and Paul · parish history
sources.notes: Reports 100 × 160 ft church dimensions and 191 ft twin spires. Tower bases and nave mass remain approximate.

sources.title: Washington Square · San Francisco Recreation and Parks
sources.notes: Confirms park identity, lawn setting, Filbert/Stockton address, and 3.17 acre area. Scene includes surrounding blocks.

objects.label: Filbert Street
objects.description: Observed east–west street separating the church from the square; curb edges simplified.

objects.label: Union Street
objects.description: Observed southern edge of the square; road width varies near Columbus.

objects.description: Observed street west of the main square; extends through the study boundary.

objects.description: Observed eastern park frontage; straightened between visible junctions.

objects.label: Washington Square lawn
objects.description: Broad continuous lawn traced from visible green edge. Tree crowns obscure portions of the western boundary.

objects.label: South garden

objects.label: Children’s play area

objects.label: Marini Plaza

objects.label: Church forecourt
objects.description: Narrow visible paved approach between the church frontage and Filbert Street.

objects.label: Saints Peter and Paul
objects.description: Observed church roof and approximate ground footprint. Parish reports 100 × 160 ft overall; nave mass height estimated at 23 m. Towers are separate objects.
